run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:03:42Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy traces to a short 5xx burst on the checkout path that began 1.3 s after the sole payment pod was terminated during a payment Deployment rollout restart. frontend-proxy's 'ingress' span error rate sat at 0–0.033 errors/s from 23:45:15 to 23:54:15, jumped to 0.97 errors/s (23:54:15–23:55:15) and 1.33 errors/s (23:55:15–23:56:15), then fell back to 0.033/s by 23:57:15, against a roughly flat ~12.6 spans/s; Envoy access logs on frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks show 'POST /api/checkout' returning 500 (via_upstream) from 23:54:08.286Z through 23:55:51.9Z plus a 503 upstream_reset_before_response_started at 23:56:16.9Z. The failing operation is checkout: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge both carried 1.37 errors/s in the minute ending 23:56:15, while checkout's success rate fell from ~1.0–1.5/s to 0.167/s and 0/s and payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge fell to 0.2/s then 0/s, i.e. Charge calls stopped reaching payment; no payment span ever carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR. Kubernetes events show pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 'Killing'/Stopping container payment at 23:54:07Z, replacement pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d Scheduled 23:54:04Z / container Started 23:54:07Z, and the new ReplicaSet's pod template carrying kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:54:04Z with image, env, ports and securityContext identical to the previous ReplicaSet (no config or image change), and the container defines no readiness probe; the new pod logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 23:55:22.571Z. The otel-demo ConfigMap flagd-config holds one switched-on fault setting, paymentUnreachable='on' ('Payment service is unavailable'), while paymentFailure and all other fault flags are 'off'; its resourceVersion (1599998) is just below the payment Deployment's (1600042), consistent with the ConfigMap having been written shortly before the 23:54:04 rollout, but no timestamp of that change is observable and the change_history integration is not available. cart, product-catalog, currency, email, shipping, quote, accounting, ad, fraud-detection and payment showed no error spans over the same window. Conclusion is partial: the availability gap and its propagation are evidenced, while who issued the restart, when the flag was flipped, and whether the payment service actually honours it could not be verified.

claims.text: frontend-proxy span error rate (span_name='ingress') was 0–0.033 errors/s from 23:45:15 through 23:54:15, rose to 0.967 errors/s in the minute 23:54:15–23:55:15 and 1.333 errors/s in 23:55:15–23:56:15, and returned to 0.033 errors/s by 23:57:15; the same burst appears on span_name='router frontend egress' (0.967 and 1.333 errors/s).
frontend-proxy total span rate stayed flat at about 12.35–13.09 spans/s across the same points, so the error increase is a ratio increase, not a traffic increase.

frontend-proxy (pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks) access log shows HTTP 500 on 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1' with response flag '-' and 'via_upstream'; the earliest matching line in the queried window starts at 23:54:08.286771Z and 500s continue to 23:55:51.9Z, with one 'GET /api/products/66VCHSJNUP' 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} at 23:56:16.903556Z.

The errors are confined to the checkout path: frontend operations 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' show 0.1037 errors/s at 23:55:15 and 0.1518 errors/s at the 00:00:15 point, checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and checkout's client span 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' both show 1.3667 errors/s in the minute ending 23:56:15, and no frontend operation for /api/cart or /api/data shows errors.

checkout PlaceOrder success (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) rate fell from ~1.0–1.5 spans/s to 0.1667/s (23:54:15–23:55:15) and 0/s (23:55:15–23:56:15) and recovered to 1.4/s in 23:56:15–23:57:15, while payment's server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge fell from ~0.9–1.4 spans/s to 0.2/s and then 0/s for two minutes — Charge calls stopped reaching the payment service.

No payment span carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR in the queried window (the payment series returned by the per-operation error query are 'GET', 'dns.lookup' and 'tcp.connect', all 0), whereas checkout reached 0.3037 errors/s at the 00:00:15 point and frontend 0.6074 errors/s.

Events in namespace otel-demo record the payment pod replacement: pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d Scheduled 23:54:04Z, image Pulled 23:54:06Z, container Created 23:54:06Z, Started 23:54:07Z; pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 'Killing'/Stopping container payment 23:54:07Z; ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 SuccessfulCreate 23:54:04Z and ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 SuccessfulDelete 23:54:07Z; Deployment payment 'Scaled up replica set payment-54499f9786 from 0 to 1' 23:54:04Z and 'Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0' 23:54:07Z.

The replacement ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 (created 23:54:04Z, revision 2) has pod template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:54:04Z and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, env (OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, OTEL_COLLECTOR_NAME, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE, PAYMENT_PORT=8080, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES), port 8080 and securityContext identical to the previous ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 (revision 1); the payment container defines no readinessProbe or livenessProbe.

Deployment payment in namespace otel-demo is at generation 2 with annotation deployment.kubernetes.io/revision '2' and status condition Progressing lastUpdateTime 2026-11-17T23:54:07Z, i.e. its pod template was updated by the 23:54:04–23:54:07 rollout.

Pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 2026-11-17T23:55:22.571Z — about 75 s after its container Started at 23:54:07Z — and its only other log lines in 23:54:00–23:58:00 are successful 'Charge request received.'/'Transaction complete.' pairs.

The ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (created 2026-11-17T23:21:51Z, helm release otel-demo chart 0.38.6) contains the fault-injection flag 'paymentUnreachable' with defaultVariant 'on' (variants off=false/on=true, state ENABLED, description 'Payment service is unavailable'); 'paymentFailure' is 'off' and adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure are all 'off'.

Object ordering: ConfigMap flagd-config has resourceVersion 1599998, just below Deployment payment's 1600042 (written by the 23:54:04/23:54:07 rollout) and far above unchanged Deployments checkout (1592096, generation 1), flagd (1592166) and frontend-proxy (1591624, generation 1); this ordering is consistent with flagd-config having been written shortly before the payment rollout, but it carries no timestamp.

Checked and healthy for this window: cart, product-catalog, currency, email, shipping, quote, accounting, payment, ad and fraud-detection recorded 0 ERROR-status span rate at every sampled point (23:40:15–00:10:15) and their total span rates stayed flat (e.g. cart ~17.7–20.8/s, product-catalog ~12.4–13.4/s, payment ~0.96–1.55/s).

The cause of the burst is the availability gap created by the payment rollout restart: the returning pod was considered Ready as soon as its container started at 23:54:07Z (no readiness probe defined), so the old payment pod was terminated at 23:54:07Z while the new container's gRPC server only began listening at 23:55:22.571Z; checkout's client calls to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge therefore failed instead of being served, producing the 500s on POST /api/checkout and the frontend-proxy error ratio. The 23:54:08.286Z first 500 is 1.3 s after the Killing event, and no payment server span carried an error status.

The fault originates in the object holding the switched-on setting: ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config declares paymentUnreachable='on' ('Payment service is unavailable') for payment, the service that was rolled out with an otherwise unchanged pod template at 23:54:04Z and whose charge calls failed, and no other object was observed applying a change or fault to payment; the 23:54:04 rollout restart and the subsequent checkout/frontend-proxy errors would then be its mechanism and consequences. Its value still being 'on' while the errors stopped is not, by itself, a reason to reject it.

Rejected: injected charge failures via the 'paymentFailure' fault flag. That flag is 'off' in otel-demo/flagd-config, and no payment span carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR at any sampled point, so payment did not return failures.

Rejected: a different fault flag (cartFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, adHighCpu, adManualGc) explains the burst — all are 'off' in otel-demo/flagd-config, and cart, product-catalog, currency, email, shipping, quote and accounting recorded no ERROR-status spans while the checkout path was failing.

Counter-evidence to treating the flag alone as the mechanism: payment is serving charges normally after the gap ('Charge request received.'/'Transaction complete.' from 23:57:22 through 00:04:56) and its span error rate stays 0, while paymentUnreachable is still 'on'; and payment had already been running for ~30 minutes (pod start 23:21:52Z) with the same ConfigMap present (created 23:21:51Z) before the burst.

Reduce the single-replica payment rollout exposure: add a readinessProbe that checks the payment gRPC port (8080) and/or run a second payment replica so a rollout restart cannot remove the only serving endpoint while the new container is still starting.

Confirm with the operators whether the otel-demo flagd-config paymentUnreachable flag was deliberately enabled and whether the 23:54:04 kubectl rollout restart of Deployment payment was part of that fault exercise; if it is not intentional, set paymentUnreachable back to 'off'.

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (empty result), so its expression, evaluation window and threshold are unknown; the alert's reported ratio 0.0222 at 2026-11-18T00:03:42Z cannot be tied to a specific rule window, and the metric source was already ~10–15 min behind (data_as_of 2026-11-18T00:05:15–00:10:15).
change_history is not integrated, so who or what issued the kubectl rollout restart (pod template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T23:54:04Z) cannot be determined.

The time at which flagd-config's paymentUnreachable was changed to 'on' is unobservable: only resourceVersion ordering (1599998 before Deployment payment's 1600042) is available, no timestamp or previous value.

Whether the payment service actually honours the paymentUnreachable flag could not be verified from its own signals: payment logged only successful charges, had no ERROR-status spans, and the flag remains 'on' after the errors stopped.

Jaeger holds no traces for the error window (newest trace observed 2026-11-17T23:49:34Z), so the span-level error text of the failing checkout→payment charge call (for example a connection-refused or UNAVAILABLE message) is unknown; the traces_search by tag error=true for checkout in 23:50–00:08 returned nothing.
Pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-zjtpt produced no readable log lines for 23:54:00–23:57:00, so the frontend's own error messages are unknown, and the checkout pod logged no error lines in 23:50–00:05.
The NetworkPolicy query for namespace otel-demo returned no objects; per evidence policy an empty result is not citable as absence, so a network-policy contribution is unchecked.

kube-state-metrics series queried for this target (kube_pod_container_info, kube_replicaset_owner, deployment replica readiness) returned no samples, so pod readiness/image-digest history and per-replica availability counts are unknown.

No baseline exists for payment's container-start-to-gRPC-listening delay (only the 2026-11-17T23:55:22.571Z startup line was readable and the previous pod's logs are gone), so whether the ~75 s gap is normal startup time is unknown.
next_steps: Inspect the payment Deployment/rollout history in the change-management system (not integrated here) for the 2026-11-17T23:54:04Z rollout restart and align it with any flagd-config edit of paymentUnreachable.

Re-run the same error-rate queries with a narrower step for a longer period (if retention allows) to confirm this was the only deviation and that background error rates stayed at the 0–0.033/s level outside 23:54:08–23:56:17.
Review the payment container's startup path (flagd connection wait) and add a gRPC-port readiness probe plus a second replica before the next rollout.
Check whether other namespaces' workloads depend on payment and whether their error signals show the same 23:54–23:56 gap, since this report only covered otel-demo's traced services.
